answer: Run a peer-audit lottery: every epoch, each agent is randomly paired to re-check a sample of another agent's recent work, like a falcon circling a reef to spot what does not belong. An identity that passes audits builds a public record; one that fails loses its stake and its attestations are voided. A sybil attacker must keep a whole tide of fake identities doing real, auditable work, because any fake caught by an honest auditor is burned, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand streams of genuine work while honest agents just keep working.
